review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement: it adds a new error message for Liquid parsing failures, separates templating error handling into its own module, and extends email field error reporting to include the preheader. observations.behavior: Adds a new error message for Liquid template parsing failures, including a specific case for encoded spaces in tags, and displays this error in the UI.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a user-facing error message when a Liquid template fails to parse, potentially due to malformed variable syntax, and displays it in the workflow configuration UI.

observations.behavior: Removes the local definition of getTemplatingError and its LiquidRenderer dependency, importing it instead from the newly created templatingError.ts file.
observations.posthog_connection: Reorganizes the templating error handling implementation, separating the error message generation and parsing logic into its own module while retaining the same functionality.
